purpose: Test whether changing only the maximum training-fold tile-trigger budget improves the precision-efficiency operating point of the existing scene selector.

protocol.budget_semantics: maximum trigger fraction on each training fold; not the held-out actual trigger rate
protocol.prediction_policy: UAVDT always A_Original; VisDrone uses C2_area2048 only when selected by its held-out fold rule

bootstrap.sampling: sample 94 sequence groups with replacement; include all images in each sampled group
bootstrap.uavdt_handling: all 1320 UAVDT images held fixed in every replicate
bootstrap.paired_comparison: all four prediction policies evaluated on the same sampled sequence groups

stage6_3d_a_bootstrap.interpretation_limit: This is a conditional cluster bootstrap for VisDrone sequence-sampling uncertainty. UAVDT is fixed, and the 247 VisDrone development images are resampled; this is not an independent external test.

stage6_3d_b_runtime.runtime_estimation_method: Recompose per-image read/original/feature/rule/tile/fusion components from Stage 6.3D-B's 3-repeat CSV; for B50/B70 use the matching measured rule-cost series, for other budgets use mean Loose/Medium rule cost. No new inference.

runtime_estimate.runtime_source: Stage 6.3D-B stage6_3d_runtime_per_image.csv; no new inference was run
